title: Isilumkiso Esingaphantsi Komhlaba
intro: Khawuthelekelele umi ecaleni kwendawo yokumba enzulu njengoko amazwi enyuka evela ngaphantsi kwaye ihlabathi elingaphezulu lithule. I-Qur'an igcina le ndawo njengesilumkiso: uluntu luyala oko kuziswa ngabathunywa, isohlwayo siyavalwa, kwaye kwanomgqumo walo uba yinxalenye yobungqina. Ngowuphi iqela elithetha ngaloo vesi?
clues: Sikhunjulwa kwiQur'an njengeqela elichazwe likamva elinye elilinganayo endaweni yegama lomntu ngamnye.
Sasilahlile isigidimi esasiziswa ngabathunywa, nangona oko babekuthetha kwakuyinyani.
Ubuwena bethu obukhunjulwayo bubotshelelwe kukunqunyulwa okunzulu komhlaba, kwaye olo phawu lwaba yinxalenye yegama lethu.
Ngomhla omiselweyo, sakhutshwa saza sarhuqelwa emlilweni.
Asikwazanga ukuzikhusela kwisohlwayo, kwaye asikwazanga ukuva ukugquma kwaso.
Ubuso bethu bebuya kujika bube semlilweni, size siqhutyelwe kuwo; xa sibuzwa, besisithi siphakathi kwabo bangenakukwazi ukuphendula.

Ukusindiswa nokunikezelwa ithuba lokungena kwiigadi ezingunaphakade
